items.question: Where did Kathleen Doyle play college basketball?
items.answer: Kathleen Doyle played at Iowa and was named Big Ten Player of the Year as a senior in 2020.

items.question: What WNBA team did Kathleen Doyle play for?
items.answer: The Indiana Fever drafted Kathleen Doyle 14th overall in 2020, and she played 18 regular-season games for them that season.
